summary: Today presents a mixed legal and retail updates landscape, driven by landmark judicial rulings on corporate insolvency and deep-tech AI content regulation. Simultaneously, retail counsel must note surging festive demand projections and aggressive market entries in the FMCG sector.

bullets.text: The Supreme Court ruled that a policy-navigation role establishes related-party status under IBC Section 5(24)(m)(i), upholding debenture holder exclusion from Creditor Committees.
The Delhi High Court ordered AAP to remove AI-generated social media posts depicting Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta as a liquor vendor.
Nielsen data shows e-commerce's share of India's FMCG retail sales has tripled over the last two years.
CAIT projects Dhanteras festive trade to cross Rs 1 lakh crore, with gold and silver sales alone exceeding Rs 60,000 crore.
Britannia's CEO stated Reliance's Rs 5 Independence biscuits will struggle to replicate Campa's market disruption in India's competitive biscuit sector.
